content_blocks.body_en: Bambu PLA Translucent, available in 10 vibrant colors, is perfect for crafting lightshades and decorative lanterns. Its frosted finish diffuses light beautifully. With enhanced durability, it’s ideal for long-term indoor lighting and décor. Customize the shape of light with Bambu PLA Translucent!

content_blocks.title_en: Diffuse Light in a Splash of Colors
content_blocks.body_en: From soft pastels to vibrant candy hues, Bambu PLA Translucent offers a stunning range of frosted tones that add both subtle elegance and bold vibrancy to your prints. Its unique matte finish mimics the look of hand-blown frosted glass, making it ideal for crafting light shades, vases, and stained glass decor. PLA Translucent seamlessly bonds with any PLA filament, making adding a translucent accent to your prints as effortless as swapping colors mid‑print.

content_blocks.title_en: Craft Stained Glass Art That Endures
content_blocks.body_en: Bambu PLA Translucent strikes the perfect balance between visual translucency and everyday durability. It offers greater impact and aging resistance compared to generic translucent PLA, ensuring your prints last longer and perform better over time.
All printing parameters are embedded in RFID, which can be read through our AMS (Automatic Material System).

1.Accessory Compatibility
Not compatible with Hotend with Stainless Steel Nozzle 0.2 mm.

2.Drying Recommendations
Dry before use to ensure the best print quality and consistent finish. Store in a dry environment after use. For more details, please refer to: Filament drying instructions on WIKI.

3.Appearance Change
Please note that the transparency of prints may vary depending on factors such as size, thickness, structure, and printing parameters (including speed, nozzle temperature, and infill density). To enhance translucency, please refer to the printing tips on WIKI.
PLA Translucent has a frosted glass texture that diffuses light well, while PETG Translucent is more see-through with a crystal-clear finish.

4.Printability
PLA Translucent is more beginner-friendly than PETG Translucent.

5.Safety Tips
Please store the filament in a cool, dark, and dry environment away from direct sunlight and high temperatures.
Please keep filament and any broken fragments out of reach of infants, children, and pets to prevent swallowing or choking.
For opened filament, we recommend drying before use according to the wiki’s recommended temperature and time settings.
Please print this filament in a well-ventilated area, or install an effective air filtration or exhaust system.
As this filament is not food-grade, please avoid using finished prints for food storage or contact.
